Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
Can i use a wooden stake together with a Scorpion sting.
I'm not sure, as it is a melee weapon and scorpion sting does not imply
melee weapons, but the minion with the stake does handdamage as a
strike.

Tim

Wooden Stake
Melee weapon. Minion with this equipment inflicts hand damage as a
strike. If more than 1 damage is inflicted with this weapon, all
additional damage is aggravated. If the victim is sent to torpor,
transfer this card to the victim; the victim does not untap while in
torpor.

Scorpion Sting
strike: +1 hand damage. (S) As above, and this strike cannot be dodged.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tim Eijpe wrote:
>
> Can i use a wooden stake together with a Scorpion sting.
> I'm not sure, as it is a melee weapon and scorpion sting does not imply
> melee weapons, but the minion with the stake does handdamage as a
> strike.

No. A Scorpion Sting strike deals strength+1 damage. Scorpion Sting
(unlike Lucky Blow, et. al) says nothing about using the strike with
a melee weapon.

Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 25 Sep 2000, Tim Eijpe wrote:

> Can i use a wooden stake together with a Scorpion sting.

No.

> I'm not sure, as it is a melee weapon and scorpion sting does not imply
> melee weapons, but the minion with the stake does handdamage as a
> strike.

The terminology on the cards is confusing. Strikes that inflict hand
damage are not the same as strikes that inflict damage based on hand
damage. You could use Lucky Blow with Wooden stake, because it explicitly
excludes melee weapons

> Wooden Stake
> Melee weapon. Minion with this equipment inflicts hand damage as a
> strike.

Interpret this as, "Minion with this equipment inflicts weapon-damage
based on his strength", strength being defined as the amount of damage the
minion would currently be able to inflict if he struck with a normal
(non-strike card) hand strike.
